newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says watching NTT's reorganisation moves.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says watching NTT's reorganisation moves.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said in a statement on Thursday that it would be closely monitoring the planned reorganisation of Japanese telecoms giant Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp.
Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry last week unveiled a new corporate structure for NTT that will turn the huge enterprise into a family of firms under a single holding company.
Under the plan, NTT will be allowed to realise its long-held dream of entering the international phone market, although this could take a few years.

Moody's said it would continue to assess possible negative implications for NTT shareholders that may result from the structure of the reorganised entities. Moody's said it would also closely monitor changes in the competitive market environment and their impact on NTT's fundamental strengths.
Moody's said it currently rates approximately $22 billion of NTT's long-term debt at Aaa.
